correctness.rationale: With probability-normalized spherical harmonics on S^3, the reproducing kernel is (ell+1)U_ell, making K_ell PSD. The exact sin((ell+1)theta)/sin(theta) identity, including both endpoint values, proves K_{L-2}=L(I+P)-J, K_{L-1}=L(I-P), and K_{ell+L}=K_ell+L(I+(-1)^ell P). Diagonalization on the antipodal even/odd subspaces yields N<=2L and the exact spectra; the positive definite added 2kL term proves all higher-degree parity-compatible surjectivity. Binary dihedral even-n groups give infinitely many N=2L examples. The standalone exact rational checker verifies the angular hypotheses and Chebyshev identities for 600-cell and Q8. No finite computation substitutes for the proof.

originality.rationale: The claimed new object is a universal sharp cardinality-and-all-degree sampling theorem for arbitrary antipodal S^3 configurations with root-of-unity angular differences, not merely the known 600-cell or 24-cell design. Compared to three relevant primary sources, own accessible matching claims, and semantic mathematical research search results, no covering statement or implication with the general quantifiers and exact period-ramp was identified. Group-character material may imply special cases but does not imply the unrestricted geometric result. Publication-priority risk persists, particularly an incompletely retrievable older primary article and possible general spherical-code bounds.

value.rationale: The shared angular root-of-unity constraint is natural for finite quaternionic subgroups and exact spherical cubature. The theorem forces the sharp universal cardinality ceiling N<=2L, identifies an exact one-dimensional failure at the extremal penultimate degree, and proves optimal exact-degree interpolation at the next and every higher degree with a tight critical frame. Infinite binary-dihedral equality cases and the 600-cell show this is an attainable structural classification rather than an unmotivated finite table calculation.
